variants.name: Price in focus
variants.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Generate ONE standalone SQUARE 1:1 preview poster for Russian-speaking adults. Not a contact sheet. Text must be large, mobile-readable and exact. Header at top: "ПРАГА" once. Lower-left compact information: "15-21.11.2026" once, "599 € / чел." once and "при двухместном размещении" once; make the condition easily readable, not fine print. Small tasteful brand at bottom: "Simba by Bon Tours" once. Small clear numbered preview label at top right: "ВАРИАНТ 1" once. Only replace NUMBER with this variant number. No extra text, no phone, no QR, no slogan, no all-city list, no watermark, no made-up claims. Keep 6% safe margins, headline top, strong main image middle, conditions lower left. Avoid snowfall and Christmas decor. No input images or identity reference supplied; create an original adult realistic lion mascot, not a child's cartoon, not a costume.
Scene and art direction: A sophisticated high-contrast graphic travel sale advertisement, charcoal background and restrained cyan blocks, with a telephoto photographic Prague skyline softly behind. Strong oversized price but do not repeat it. Adult photoreal anthropomorphic male lion with tawny fur and full dark-gold mane in navy wool travel coat, standing on the right with a small leather suitcase. Credible lion face and paws, human upright posture. Clean modern social impact art direction.
